headline: Pullback after a 371M-volume impulse, resting on the 4H 20 EMA / breakout retest

meta.market_state_note: A young recovery met immediate supply — favours a pullback or failed-breakout resolution, not a clean trend trade; no edge at spot until the $0.230–0.236 pivot resolves.

factors.evidence: Based at $0.1696 (06-06), reclaimed the $0.20–0.22 congestion on a huge 06-11 impulse, peaked $0.2653 — but that's a lower high vs the $0.2929 60-day high, and 06-12 rejected hard.
Price above — but 20<50 (stack still bearish; reclaim unconfirmed).
Price far below; anchor is from a much higher prior regime — not a reliable read here, flagged.
Recovered from oversold, above its MA — momentum has turned up.
06-11 impulse was 371M (3.3× avg) = genuine demand; but 06-12 rejection was also high (179M).
Clean HH/HL into $0.2653, then orderly pullback; today's low $0.2317 dipped under the $0.2349 impulse HL — minor structure crack.
Price $0.234 sitting exactly on the 20 EMA — testing it from above.
Chart anchor unreliable; a proper $0.1696-low anchor would sit ~$0.22 (price above) but unconfirmed in feed.
RSI fading with price; CVD bearish divergence at the high (see Phase 4).
Pullback volume bled 45M → 4M = constructive contraction; offset by aggressive CVD taker-selling.

setup.type: Pullback (unconfirmed) — Failed Breakout the bear alternative
setup.thesis: No clean trade yet. The pullback-long is the nearer structure but is unconfirmed and fought by CVD distribution. Wait for the $0.2300–0.2360 zone to resolve rather than pre-positioning into a coin-flip.
setup.not: Not Trend Continuation (trend too young), not yet a confirmed Failed Breakout (support not lost).

verdict.rationale: Transitional — no actionable trade at $0.234. If it confirms long (reclaim/hold $0.236+ on volume) it becomes a Pullback / trend-following entry; if it loses $0.230 it becomes a Failed Breakout. Wait for the $0.2300–0.2360 zone to resolve rather than pre-position into a coin-flip.

evidence_matrix.reading: Recovered above $0.20–0.22 congestion on a 371M impulse but capped at a lower high ($0.2653 < $0.2929) with a fresh rejection
Clean HH/HL impulse then orderly pullback; today's $0.2317 low dipped under the $0.2349 impulse HL — structure softening
4H RSI fading with price; CVD bearish divergence at the $0.2653 high
Rose to 70.1M on the rally (new longs), fell ~3M on the pullback = profit-taking, not fresh shorts
+0.0069%/8h, near neutral; no crowded longs, no squeeze risk
−2.86M near its lows; −3.78M in 24h while price flat = heavy distribution
Chart anchor stale ($0.7538 deep cycle); proper swing-anchored read unavailable
06-12 swept the $0.2653 highs then rejected = sweep-and-fail of the highs

analyst_summary: CRV is Neutral / Transitional: a young recovery that produced one violent 371M-volume demand impulse off $0.1696, immediately met by a high-volume rejection at a lower high ($0.2653 < $0.2929) and CVD distribution — two-sided, with neither edge yet in control.

The pullback-long is the nearer structure — price holds the 4H 20 EMA ($0.2334) and breakout-retest shelf on contracting volume with neutral funding and OI profit-taking — but it is unconfirmed and fought by the single strongest tell, CVD (−3.78M distribution in 24h).

Net read is WAIT: no edge at $0.234. A 4H reclaim/hold of $0.236+ on volume confirms the pullback long ($0.2653 → $0.2929); a 4H close below $0.2300 flips it to a failed breakout toward the $0.218–0.223 EMA cluster.

Notes: CVD is the swing tell — price holding while CVD bleeds is either bid absorption (resolves up) or quiet distribution (resolves down); if price reclaims $0.236 but CVD keeps falling, fade the long. CRV rode BTC's bounce ($61.5k→$63.7k) and is high-beta — a BTC roll-over would override the long and accelerate the failed-breakout path.
bottom_line: Transitional coin-flip — no actionable trade at $0.234; wait for the $0.230–0.236 pivot to resolve before taking either the pullback long or the failed-breakout short.

bull_case: 30%-impulse off $0.1696 on 371M demand volume, price above both daily EMAs with RSI turned up, pulling back on contracting volume into the 4H 20 EMA + breakout retest with neutral funding and OI profit-taking — holds → $0.2653 → $0.29.
bear_case: High-volume daily rejection (shooting star) at a lower high ($0.2653 < $0.2929), CVD bearish divergence + −3.78M distribution in 24h, daily EMA stack still bearish, high-sweep-and-fail — loses $0.230 → $0.218–0.223 EMA cluster → $0.21/$0.20.

failure_scenario: Price chops the $0.230–0.240 zone, the CVD distribution wins, $0.230 gives way, and it back-fills to the daily-EMA cluster ($0.218–0.223) — turning the would-be pullback into a failed breakout.

derivatives_summary: OI and funding show no aggressive new shorting and no crowded longs, but CVD reveals heavy distribution into the move — the rally is being quietly sold, so the pullback is not yet a confirmed dip-buy.
conclusion: Transitional — Pullback (trend-following) on confirmation above $0.236, or Failed Breakout (countertrend) below $0.230; not trend-following until the breakout proves it holds.
